definitions.gloss: a visible blue vein, especially on the forehead when angry
definitions.explanation: refers to veins becoming visible, particularly used to describe a sign of anger or irritation

examples.japanese: {青筋|あおすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てて→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{怒|おこ}る→怒る：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: To get angry with veins bulging.

notes:
EXPRESSION OF ANGER:
{青筋|あおすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ is an idiomatic expression meaning to be visibly angry, with the image of veins becoming prominent on the forehead or temple due to intense emotion.

USAGE:
Almost always used in the expression {青筋|あおすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (to make veins stand out = to be furious).
